notes: Evaluates Workflow Step 00 (Problem) skill: PROJECT_INTENT.md scope/non-goal gate, surface registry lookup, local_semantic_embed duplicate/insight check, 3-5 sentence 4-part draft into specs/drafts/, and zero premature ID allocation.

evals.name: non-goal-proposal-redirected-before-draft
evals.prompt: Propose building an unrelated billing UI inside a repository whose PROJECT_INTENT.md Non-Goals explicitly exclude UI hosting.
evals.expected_output: Reads PROJECT_INTENT.md first, detects conflict with Non-Goals / Out of Scope, halts before creating drafts or allocating IDs, and offers Redirect / Amend first / Decline dispositions.
assertions: Reads PROJECT_INTENT.md scope and Non-Goals prior to drafting
Presents Redirect / Amend first / Decline dispositions instead of drafting a ticket
Never calls mint-id.sh or creates specs/<id>/

evals.name: file-first-four-part-draft-and-handoff
evals.prompt: Propose fixing silent audit loss when eject output dir is read-only.
evals.expected_output: Checks PROJECT_INTENT.md and both surface registries, runs local_semantic_embed over specs/archive/insights for duplicates, composes a 3-5 sentence 4-part proposal (Problem, Proposed approach, Surfaces affected, Ask) framed in outcome terms, writes specs/drafts/<slug>.md with specs/drafts/.gitignore intact, and offers /cadence-triage --file-only specs/drafts/<slug>.md.
assertions: Runs local_semantic_embed on :11434 to check prior tickets and insights
Writes concise 4-part outcome proposal into specs/drafts/<slug>.md (never creating spec.md, metadata.yaml, or calling --reserve)
Offers /cadence-triage --file-only specs/drafts/<slug>.md to avoid inline CLI argument truncation
